src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: 2012 court-drawn congressional plan (Favors v. Cuomo, E.D.N.Y., 3-judge court, Mar. 19, 2012, No. 11-CV-5632); 27 districts
N.Y. Court of Appeals, Harkenrider v Hochul (describes the 2012 federal-court plan and cites Favors v Cuomo, 2012 WL 928223, Mar. 19, 2012)

Used in the 2012 through 2020 elections; the Legislature could not agree on a congressional map in 2012, so the federal court drew it. Census cb_2020 cd116 file: 27 districts (the 116th Congress's lines, unchanged until 2022).

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: Chapter 16 of the Laws of 2012 (S.6696 / A.9525, signed Mar. 15, 2012), with technical corrections in Chapter 20 of 2012 (S.6755, signed Mar. 27, 2012); 63 Senate districts
N.Y. Assembly bill page A.9525 (2011-12): signed chap. 16
Used in the 2012 through 2020 elections. Census cb_2020 sldu file: LSY 2018, 63 districts; no Senate plan changed between 2012 and the 2022 court map.
